notes: Double release in USB core. URB freed both in completion handler and error path. Fixed by NULL-check and early return after first free.
Double unlock in kernel mutex. Mutex unlocked both in normal path and error cleanup. Fixed by removing duplicate unlock in cleanup.
Double connection close in nginx HTTP/3. Connection closed twice when GOAWAY frame received during request processing. Fixed by adding closed-flag check.
Double BIO_free in OpenSSL. BIO freed when SSL_free calls it internally AND explicitly in caller. Fixed by removing explicit BIO_free since SSL_free handles it.
Double cleanup in libcurl. curl_easy_cleanup called twice in multi-handle error path. Fixed by guard variable preventing double cleanup.
